mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5%, it signals imminent recession risk triggering central bank intervention that generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signal broad economic weakness that triggers monetary easing, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply recovery phase (INDPRO below 100 and rising), improving industrial output reduces supply constraints and lowers inflation expectations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and rising, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts signals strong consumer demand for durable goods, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals imminent monetary tightening that increases discount rates and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in payrolls and decreases in unemployment rate signal a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or interaction Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), rising interest rates compress equity valuations and generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
